shortDescription: Vitalik said India has a large community of developers working on Ethereum and zero-knowledge proofs. According to ChainCatcher, none of the previous 11 Devcon or Devconnect events had been held in India.

title: Ethereum Co-Founder Vitalik Responds to Debate Over India's Devcon Venue
